# Waymark 0.2.8

- Pet farming routes: select target pets, prioritize known unfinished levels, combine shared farming regions, preview stops and save a named per-character route. Verteron and Altgard use general region references; routes are straight-line planning aids, not safe terrain paths or exact spawns.
- Progress details show manual marks separately from saved game observations, with observation time and independent first-clear/current-period/reward states when supported.
- First-launch map/minimap setup for new installations, available again from Settings. Existing installations retain their settings without an automatic setup popup.
- Current and available update notes in Settings. New automatic update backups include a full archive that the normal Restore dialog can open. The owned reader is stopped before snapshot creation.

Existing data is preserved. No new recording or game action is required. Automatic dungeon/stronghold/teleport completion and precise network movement still need independent gameplay evidence.
